$comment: Video: the reel (agd-playground src/components/context-reel, a pure function of t, 10 s at 1920 by 1080) with its copy as flags, and short dot-field loops in the style of the brand film's DotField (context-dev-video src/DotField.tsx: one still grid of same-sized dots, thinning by noise; here each loop moves on a sine, so the last frame meets the first).

copy.name: Context.dev
copy.headline: Web data API for AI Agents
copy.markdown: Turn any webpage into clean Markdown for your agent
copy.quote: We’re seeing much higher activation rates for our free trials and sign-ups because of it.
copy.statLabel: of pages returned as clean, usable content
copy.cardBlue: Context.dev gives your agent the web data it needs to finish a task

notes: Type: the reel set Switzer and Geist Mono; tokens.css sets Rethink Sans for the sans and the site's mono, so the reel does too.

Colors: the stage ground #eceef2 is bg-frame (#F2F2F2); the dark pills #15161a and #2a2c33 are neutral-90 and neutral-80; the benchmark's #1e1e1e and #e3e6ec are neutral-90 and neutral-10; #111 is black; the attribution's #6b7280 is text-muted (#666666); the card's lit dots #e8eaf0 are blue-10.
This copy is the sample --sample fills in: the benchmark's rows are Acme placeholders and the testimonial's person is a role at Acme. Only the name and address are drawn without being passed.

edges.name: Edge dots
edges.description: The site's hero texture: dots near the left and right edges fraying toward the middle, the fray breathing in and out.
